verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a workstation GPU, a hardware accelerator. Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is an orchestration-software capability, not something buyers compare GPU cards on, so this is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the product or its first-party stack shipping a recurring scheduler that would make the axis apply; mentions of 'workflows' only describe accelerating workloads, and MIG partitioning is not scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
